adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` but never attaches a `.catch(...)` (unlike `save()`, which uses `.catch(popupAjaxError)`). If `destroyRecord()` rejects, no error is surfaced and `deleteHost` is not sent, so the row will remain in the UI with a silently failed delete (and likely an unhandled promise rejection).
